scope: English and Scottish men’s league levels 1–4; regular league matches and match statistics only, 2022-23 through 2024-25.

source.dataDescription: Results and team-level match statistics. Football-Data credits BBC, Flashscore, ESPN Soccer, Bundesliga.de, Gazzetta.it and Football.fr for match statistics.
source.rawDataPolicy: Raw CSV downloads are kept locally outside Git; this artifact contains aggregates only.

unavailableCompetitions.name: National League / Conference
unavailableCompetitions.reason: Football-Data lists Conference result files but does not list match-stat coverage for them; excluded from this multi-stat benchmark rather than represented by goals alone.

unavailableCompetitions.name: Welsh and Northern Irish leagues
unavailableCompetitions.reason: Not present in Football-Data’s listed league data pages.

method.variance: Unbiased sample variance with denominator n−1; match totals are calculated per match, and home/away values remain separate. TeamPerMatch pools home and away team rows.
method.coverage: 24 files across 8 competitions and 3 seasons contain 8,412 match rows. All goals and card statistics are complete. One 2024-25 Scottish League One match has no shots, shots-on-target, fouls or corners; those metrics use pairwise-complete rows (539/540 for that competition) rather than treating the missing values as zero.
method.rounding: Means, sample variances, standard deviations and result rates rounded to 4 decimal places.
method.cardDefinitionNote: Football-Data notes that English and Scottish yellow-card counts omit the initial yellow when a second yellow is converted to a red; this affects comparison with sources that count both.

limitations: This is a multi-stat English and Scottish levels 1–4 sample, not a benchmark for the National League, Wales, Northern Ireland or every UK competition.
No xG, passing, possession, tackles, interceptions, saves, player-level events, player ratings or tracking/running data are provided in this common sample.
Match statistics are provider-compiled and can vary by source and season; definitions must be kept aligned before comparing to game events.
These are descriptive references, not per-match quotas, caps or instructions to alter player decisions.
